note: Supplements data/game_data.json → progression (unchanged). Only rules and numbers written in the source; anything the source leaves open is DECISION_PENDING and the engine throws CONTENT_NOT_AUTHORED instead of inventing it.

resets.source: §13.3 일일 초기화 05:00 KST, 주간 초기화 월요일 05:00 KST

waves.reason: No enemy composition per dungeon and tier exists in the source or data.

defeatStamina.reason: §11.4/§11.5 give 20 집중 per run and per sweep but do not say whether a lost battle spends it. A victory settles and spends 20; a defeat cannot settle (CONTENT_NOT_AUTHORED) until this is authored.

tierGate.reading: §11.5 gates each dungeon by account level only and names no per-tier gate, so none is added; every tier of an unlocked dungeon is open and harder tiers are limited by stage-level scaling (§11.1).

weeklyBoss.source: §11.6 구역 보스 3종(종을 삼킨 기록관·거울의 공증인·잠든 정원) + 기록소의 대사서

teamsByFloor.source: §11.7 (v0.8.1 active text) and §11.13 / data/design_policy_v0.8.json rift target

stars.source: §11.7 별 3개 기준: 3전 모두 승리 / 총 턴 수 / 남은 체력
stars.reason: The source names the total-turn and remaining-HP criteria without thresholds; a cleared floor cannot be scored or settled (CONTENT_NOT_AUTHORED) until both exist.

rotation.reason: No per-cycle assignment of the six rules to floors and no enemy lineups exist in the source or data.

floorOrder.reading: §11.7 gives the floors, their levels and rewards but no requirement to clear floor n-1 first, so floors are not gated on each other.

targetPool.source: §11.13 콘텐츠 완료·집중 정산·교류 등 대체 행동으로 달성
targetPool.reason: The selectable task list, its events, goals and points are not authored.
